text:
zoe: drafting RN + internal announce for Wed 09:45 PT maintenance window. small runtime patch but want very clear post templates (HOLD vs BROADCAST) and rollback CLI.
finn: please include the exact deploy id and a one-line rollback command. keep the internal blast <3 lines.
zoe: TL;DR draft:
- runtime v2.4.7: kv-cache stability + batching tweak
- canary: 5% for 15m -> 25% for 20m -> 100%
- no schema changes expected
ops-bot: "deploy scheduled: id rp-20250312-11 by zoe at 2025-03-12T16:45:00Z (09:45 PT). notify: #eng-sre #eng-runtime. canary: 5%->25%->100%. runbook attached: internal/release/rp-20250312-11"
sre-lead: i'll be oncall. abort thresholds: p95 > 210ms OR 5xx > 0.5% over 5m. automated alert: GPU util > 85% for 3m. i'll execute rollback if triggered.
finn: rollback snippet to include in RN:
```
# quick abort and fallback
ops-bot cancel --id rp-20250312-11 --reason "canary regression"
# pin fallback variant via console
redwood console pin model core-model --version v2.3.6
```
zoe: internal announce drafts:
HOLD: "Team — canary failed safety checks for runtime v2.4.7. Pausing and reverting to v2.3.6. SRE lead: @sre-lead. Runbook: internal/release/rp-20250312-11. Reply here for status."
BROADCAST: "Team — runtime v2.4.7 canary passed. Ramping to 100% now (T+35m). Watch p95 latency and 5xx rate. SRE lead: @sre-lead. Release notes: docs/releases/2025-03-12."
product: i'll drop a 2-line public blurb into docs/releases/2025-03-12 by EOD.
zoe: poster checklist for person sending: confirm canary OK for 20m, then post BROADCAST to #eng-releases + #all-hands T+5m; if HOLD, post HOLD and pin runbook to ticket.
sre-lead: i'll post preflight OK 15m before window and will update here if rollback occurs.
zoe: publishing draft for review — pls ack so i can attach to the deploy ticket and lock the RN.
